verdict.rationale: Airwallex's first-party refunds page confirms that merchants can issue refunds to return shopper funds, so the core refund capability exists. The snippet does not say whether partial amounts are supported, or whether refunds can be issued from the dashboard, the API, or both. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of partial-amount refunds, documented dashboard refund flow, documented refund API endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
